metadata.description: A marketplace of AI specialists that summon and delegate to each other.

plugins.description: Core system: the pros command and the skill that lets any Claude session list, summon, message, delegate to and create professionals.
plugins.name: professionals

plugins.description: System designer: turns a goal into components, interfaces, data flow, failure modes and trade-offs.
plugins.name: pro-system-designer

plugins.description: Reliability reviewer: hunts failure cases, dead hangs, races and missing deadlines before they bite.
plugins.name: pro-reliability-reviewer

plugins.description: Docs designer: READMEs and guides that explain at a glance, with diagrams.
plugins.name: pro-docs-designer

plugins.description: Voice pipeline engineer: real-time voice agents, VAD, end-of-turn detection, barge-in, latency budgets, STT and TTS.
plugins.name: pro-voice-pipeline-engineer

plugins.description: Linux ops: systemd units, hardening, timers, journald, virtual machines.
plugins.name: pro-linux-ops

plugins.description: Spec-kit driver: runs specify, clarify, plan, tasks, analyze and implement in order with checks.
plugins.name: pro-speckit-driver

plugins.description: Exhaustive researcher: covers a topic completely, counts coverage, dates every source.
plugins.name: pro-exhaustive-researcher

plugins.description: Professional smith: creates, trains, validates and publishes new professionals.
plugins.name: pro-professional-smith

plugins.description: Audit a systemd service unit for missing sandboxing directives, estimate its exposure score as systemd-analyze security does, and propose a hardened drop-in with the risk of each change.
plugins.name: pro-systemd-hardening-auditor

plugins.description: Ship gatekeeper: checks a change against the repo's own rules (tests, records, docs, secrets, version) and returns SHIP or DON'T SHIP with the exact missing items.
plugins.name: pro-ship-gatekeeper
